summary: The staff handling a repeal bring the people collecting the charge into the same discussion as the stores paying refunds.
realLife: Delaware environmental staff consulted retailers, manufacturers, consumers, distributors and revenue officials as the state left the deposit system.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: recorded transition meeting and collection responsibilities.

turns.what: Before launch, the participants work through who takes the deposit and who pays it back.
turns.pulledBy: The deposit starts before staff have issued collection instructions.
turns.writesBack: The meeting identifies which business handles each payment.

turns.what: At repeal, the participants work through which office handles the replacement fee and which claims remain payable.
turns.pulledBy: Repeal leaves claims outstanding while a fee begins.
turns.writesBack: The guidance gives separate contacts for fees and refunds.
